causebase_summary: Ivory's Rock Foundation is a Queensland-based foundation that reports activity across Australia, New Zealand and the South Pacific. As of 2026 it supports the Peace Education Program in Australia, New Zealand and the South Pacific and sponsors and hosts peace and wellbeing events in its region. The foundation describes the Peace Education Program as being delivered in high schools, universities, health-care facilities, veterans' groups, police units and correctional facilities. It states that Prem Rawat has been invited as keynote speaker for selected events when his schedule permits and that it supports activities associated with the United Nations International Day of Peace. The foundation also reports conservation and sustainability work at the Ivory's Rock property and records over 160 species, including some threatened or endangered wildlife.

data.SummaryOfActivities: Ivory s Rock Foundation (IRF) is a charitable institution for the advancement ofeducation and registered in Australia as a Company Limited by Guarantee. It wasestablished in 2010 to support a distinctive message of personal peace and fulfilment, available to everyone, regardless of race, religion, or culture, through the Peace Education Program. The Peace Education Program is delivered in over 70 countries in over 30 languages and is based on the talks of international author and peace advocate, Prem Rawat. In 2025 IRF supported the Peace Education Program inAustralia, which is currently being undertaken by corrections facilities, educational facilities in Australia, NZ and the Pacific and health and well-being centres.
